name: Podcast Publisher
description: Provides a podcast entity for publishing podcast episodes (with an analytics submodule).
project_description:
Podcast Publisher is a module to easily create your own podcast feed.

 The goal is to have a simple plug and play solution for site builders that's easily configurable and fits their needs of publishing podcasts.

 It provides a new content type Podcast , a new media type Podcast Episode and a view to render the feed.
